basics.name: Charbel Kindji
basics.label: AI Scientist · Generative Models & Structured Data
basics.summary: PhD in Computer Science (University of Rennes). Research focused on deep generative models and synthetic data detection for tabular/structured data.

work.name: Orange Innovation / IRISA - INRIA
work.position: CIFRE PhD Candidate — Tabular Foundation Models & Generative AI
work.summary: PhD program in partnership with Orange Innovation Labs and the IRISA Research Institute.
highlights: Designed and trained from scratch a foundation model for structured/tabular data (<100M parameters) — full pipeline: architecture design, pre-training corpus curation, training at scale, evaluation on unseen schemas

Designed an original Datum-wise Transformer architecture from scratch for heterogeneous tabular data — +7 AUC points and +7 accuracy points over the only published baseline, with only 3M parameters (vs. 110M+); extended via domain adaptation (gradient reversal) for cross-schema generalisation: additional +7 accuracy points
Fine-tuning and adaptation of LLMs on structured data — tabular serialisation, heterogeneous feature encoding, transfer to unseen schemas

Rigorous benchmark of 5 generative model families (VAE, GAN, Diffusion, LLMs, classical) on 16 datasets with 300 HPO trials per fold — end-to-end pipeline: data curation, model design, training, evaluation and ablations
Large-scale distributed training on HPC clusters (Jean-Zay, IGRIDA, Marcel/Orange) — Slurm job management, Tesla V100 32GB and RTX 4090 GPUs

First author on 4 international publications: AAAI 2026 (A* conference, top 3 worldwide in AI), Neurocomputing Q1, IDA 2025, COLING 2025; invited talk at CFE-CMStatistics 2025 (Birkbeck University of London, ~1 800 attendees)
Co-supervised an M2 intern (6 months) on foundation model extension — topic definition, weekly technical mentoring, and result evaluation

Designed and maintained software tests to ensure the quality of the Kurmi suite
